versions.content: If a DTC is reported as failed (UDS status testfailed flag changes from 0->1) and gets newly stored to the event memory (no entry existed for this DTC) and this DTC is configured with DemNvStorageStrategy = IMMEDIATE_- AT_FIRST_OCCURRENCE , the Dem shall trigger the immediate storage to NvM.

If a DTC is reported as failed (UDS status testfailed flag changes from 0->1) and gets newly stored to the event memory (no entry existed for this DTC) and this DTC is configured with DemNvStorageStrategy = IMMEDIATE_- AT_FIRST_OCCURRENCE , the Dem shall trigger the immediate storage to NvM.

Immediate storage of event related data at first occurrence If a DTC is configured with DemNvStorageStrategy = IMMEDIATE_AT_FIRST_- OCCURRENCE , the Dem shall trigger the storage of its event related data to NvM when the configured trigger DemEventMemoryEntryStorageTrigger to store the data occurs the first time.
